title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions that more than one contract schema references.

version.description: The contract version of the document.

identifier.description: A lower-case slug that names a case, source, step or profile.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest of the inputs, as sha256: and 64 hexadecimal digits.

relativePath.description: A slash path below the document that names it: not absolute, with no parent segment and no backslash.

regex.description: A regular expression in the RE2 subset every engine accepts.

harness.description: The agent harness that runs a prompt.

isolation.description: The isolation axis of a confined run.

provision.description: The provision axis of a confined run: where its tools come from.

network.description: The network egress axis of a confined run.

environmentEntry.description: An environment variable of a confined run, as KEY=VALUE.

condition.description: The state of an instruction during a run.

prompt.description: Either an inline prompt or a Markdown file that holds a long one.

usage.description: The model usage of one run.
